coverage: Selected Skopje programmes from the Karti ticket catalogue and full organizer announcements: theatre, family theatre, music, handball, temporary exhibitions and a participant startup weekend. This is a bounded selection, not a complete city calendar or a live ticket-inventory check. 1 and 3 November have no verified programme in this pass. Unknown prices and actual finishes remain unknown; public venue pins are building-level, not entrances. Blocked and unresolved sources were not bypassed; held candidates remain excluded. Telegram review was search-index discovery only, with zero current verified message imports.
